purpose: Generic principles for writing requirements documents when no project-specific rules exist: defines what a requirements document is, its responsibility, lifetime, and revision via additive development.
summary: Declares the principles as generic fallback; project-specific rules take precedence
Points to the requirement format template and the spec/design boundary guide
Responsibility: write what to build from the user viewpoint, with value for stakeholders
Excludes implementation methods, except already-decided matters stated concretely
Lifetime is permanent but not immutable
Revision through additive development; old document not rewritten during implementation and merged afterward
title: 要件定義書 作成原則
